picks.editorial_note: Fermilab was selected under DOE's new Genesis Mission to develop AI systems that directly control and optimize particle accelerator performance — a national-scale initiative with real infrastructure stakes for the U.S. scientific enterprise.
picks.title: DOE selects Fermilab-led AI initiative to advance particle accelerator performance

picks.editorial_note: A companion Genesis Mission award, this University of Alabama-led effort to build AI tools for sifting massive physics datasets shows DOE's AI push spanning multiple institutions in a coordinated national strategy.
picks.title: UA Preview — Aug. 24-30, 2026

picks.editorial_note: Penn's implantable Smart Neurostimulation System, built on decades of computational memory modeling, represents a genuine medical breakthrough with the potential to treat memory loss in real patients.
picks.title: A ‘breakthrough’ to restore memory | Penn Today

picks.editorial_note: SLAC's new AI compression method addresses a looming crisis in scientific data storage, letting facilities preserve subtle experimental detail as dataset sizes explode — a practical breakthrough with broad applicability across big-science facilities.
picks.title: SLAC researchers develop AI-based tool to compress data without losing detail

picks.editorial_note: MIT CSAIL's discovery of 'attribution decay' — that individual training examples often leave no traceable fingerprint in generative outputs — has significant implications for AI copyright and provenance debates.
picks.title: When AI art has no author: Study finds generated images often can’t be traced to training data

picks.editorial_note: This industry-academia cluster pairs FRONTEO's AI drug discovery platform with Science Tokyo's biomedical expertise, a concrete step toward accelerating pharmaceutical R&D through applied AI.
picks.title: FRONTEO and Science Tokyo establish industry-academia Collaborative Research Cluster for AI-driven drug discovery | Science Tokyo

picks.editorial_note: The $9M NSF-funded iDLab unifies browser-based access to national HPC centers across NCSA, UCLA and partners, directly advancing the national AI research infrastructure (NAIRR) agenda.
picks.title: NCSA Partners with UCLA for iDLab

picks.editorial_note: Northeastern's photonic metasurfaces, which use light instead of electricity for machine learning computation, tackle AI's growing power-consumption crisis with a fundamentally different hardware approach.
picks.title: This engineer sees AI and its power constraints in a new light

picks.editorial_note: EPFL's STING framework demonstrates that AI agents can be manipulated into harmful behavior through multi-turn conversation rather than single prompts, an important finding for AI safety and deployment policy.
picks.title: How attackers persuade AI agents to break the rules

picks.editorial_note: University of Houston's projection of up to 32% electricity demand growth by 2030, driven substantially by AI and data centers, carries major implications for energy policy and infrastructure planning nationwide.
picks.title: University of Houston Report Predicts U.S. Electricity Demand Could Rise 32% by 2030 | University of Houston
